title: Add RAG agent tool-calling quickstarts and docs site updates
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Added RAG agent tool-calling quickstarts, example templates, and docs site navigation updates. No breaking changes. Guides for integrations with HTTP tools and database connectors; includes deployed docs preview link.
body:
Summary: Adds three RAG agent quickstarts that demonstrate tool-calling patterns (HTTP API, SQL connector, and a scheduler tool), new RAG templates for retrieval and prompt orchestration, and updates to the docs site navigation and examples gallery. Motivation: help developers onboard faster with common tool-calling workflows and provide canonical examples aligned with Redwood's tool-calling APIs. Changes include example code, YAML templates, markdown docs, and a docs-site navigation entry. Checklist:
- [x] Add quickstart examples (js/python) for HTTP, SQL, and scheduler tools
- [x] Add RAG prompt templates and template metadata
- [x] Update docs site sidebar + gallery page
- [x] Add unit and example tests for examples repo
- [x] Ensure docs preview deploys successfully
Context: ENG-2143 requested canonical quickstarts for tool-calling after several customer questions around combining retrieval + external API calls. These examples are intentionally small (1-2 files) and linked from the main RAG docs page. Links: internal demo runbook: https://linear.app/ENG/board/ENG-2143, docs preview: https://deploy-preview-119.docs.redwood.ai
What I changed (high-level):
- redwood-examples/rag-tool-calling/ - three quickstart folders (js-http, py-sql, js-scheduler) with README, example code, and minimal Dockerfile for local runs
- redwood-docs/docs/guides/rag/tool-calling.md - new guide that references the quickstarts and describes tool-calling best practices, error handling, and security notes (KMS, credential redaction)
- redwood-docs/docs/templates/rag/ - base prompt templates (retrieval_prompt.yaml, scoring_prompt.yaml) and metadata for template gallery
- docs site: updated sidebar config and examples gallery entry to show the new quickstarts
Testing: unit tests added for the py-sql example (uses sqlite in-memory) and integration smoke tests that validate example CLI runs (mocked HTTP for js-http). Docs preview deployed and screenshot check passed. Scope/limitations: These are quickstarts (opinionated patterns), not production-ready connectors. They are intentionally minimal to show the APIs and tool-calling flow. Future work: add additional connectors (S3/VectorDB) and a tutorial that chains multiple tools across a workflow.

summary: Adds three RAG tool-calling quickstarts, prompt templates, and docs site updates to help developers adopt retrieval + tool workflows quickly. Deployed docs preview and included tests.
notes_for_maintainers: The examples use minimal deps; ensure examples CI runner has node 20 and python 3.11 for smoke tests. If expanding connectors, add a separate integration matrix to the CI to avoid long-running jobs in the examples pipeline.
